relations.text: 最大の顧客(サムズクラブを含め売上の30.0%)
relations.text_en: Largest customer (30.0% of net sales, including Sam's Club)

source.label: Cal-Maine Foods 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: Our largest customer, Walmart Inc. (including Sam's Club), accounted for 30.0%, 33.6% and 34.0% of net sales dollars for fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

companies.name: エコー・レイク・フーズ

relations.text: Echo Lake Foodsを約2.895億ドルで買収(2025年6月)
relations.text_en: Acquired Echo Lake Foods for about $289.5 million (June 2025)

source.label: Cal-Maine Foods 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: Effective June 2, 2025, we acquired Echo Lake Foods, LLC and certain related companies (collectively "Echo Lake Foods") for approximately $289.5 million.

relations.text: Crepiniへ戦略出資し、卵製品・調理食品の事業を設立
relations.text_en: Strategic investment forming an egg products and prepared foods venture

source.label: Cal-Maine Foods 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: During the second quarter of fiscal 2025, we completed a strategic investment with Crepini LLC, establishing a new egg products and prepared foods venture.

companies.name: サラ・リー・フローズン・ベーカリー

relations.text: 冷凍食品ブランドVan'sの事業を約2,480万ドルで取得(2026年5月)
relations.text_en: Bought its Van's frozen foods business for about $24.8 million (May 2026)

source.label: Cal-Maine Foods 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: Effective May 12, 2026, we acquired certain assets of the Van's Foods ("Van 's") business of Sara Lee Frozen Bakery, LLC for approximately $24.8 million.

companies.name: バイタル・ファームズ

relations.text: Vital Farmsが10-Kで、大手の卵会社の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Vital Farms names Cal-Maine among large egg competitors

source.label: Vital Farms 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We compete with large egg companies such as Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. and large international food companies such as Ornua Co-operative Limited (Kerrygold).
